episodes.title: Welcome to New York
episodes.summary: Lisa and Ethan move to New York, reconnect with old college friends and learn that some secrets are harder to keep than others.

episodes.title: Connecticut House
episodes.summary: Lisa's new career gets off to a dubious start. Meanwhile, Marianne prepares for a play and Ethan proves himself a less-than-stellar petsitter.

episodes.title: All-Nighter
episodes.summary: Facing a brutal deadline, Ethan brainstorms ideas for his Y.A. novel. Meanwhile, Sam, Lisa and Marianne meet some admirers out on the town.

episodes.title: Mission Impossible
episodes.summary: Ethan and Lisa run the gauntlet to ensure their IVF is a success. Max and Felix celebrate a special occasion. Sam opens up.

episodes.title: Party Bus
episodes.summary: Ethan organizes a wine-tasting trip for his wife and friends, but his perfectly planned excursion hits a few bumps in the road.

episodes.title: Second Wedding
episodes.summary: Tensions flare, suspicions grow and mics drop at a lavish wedding reception, where Ethan takes his new persona out for a spin.

episodes.title: Grand Cayman
episodes.summary: Lisa makes a big decision, Ethan and Sam reminisce about old times, Nick plays a prank, and Max makes an awkward confession.

episodes.title: A Night of Surprises
episodes.summary: The gang gets together to celebrate Sam's 40th birthday, where Lisa suffers a crisis of conscience and Nick's announcement catches everyone off guard.

episodes.title: The Engagement Party
episodes.summary: The gang is forced to put on their happy faces and reconnect at Max's swanky engagement party, where "severe awkwardness" is everybody's plus-one.

episodes.title: Storage Unit
episodes.summary: Sam tries to halt Jon's shaming campaign. Ethan and Lisa take a stroll down nostalgia lane. Nick makes an effort to act his age.

episodes.title: Out All Night
episodes.summary: Sam, Nick and Marianne put on their dancing shoes. Lisa makes a surprising find. Max pushes Ethan to dip his toe into the dating pool.

episodes.title: The Bachelor Party
episodes.summary: Max wants a bachelor party that's, you know, classy. But Max ought to know -- you can't always get what you want.

episodes.title: Old Habits
episodes.summary: Lisa and Charlie consider their future. Nick invites Lisa to crash his weekend with Merrill. Felix orders Max to stand up to Ethan.

episodes.title: Free Fall
episodes.summary: The gang attends an extreme funeral, Ethan gets an earful from Felix, and the awkward encounters keep on coming for Lisa.

episodes.title: Fireworks
episodes.summary: When Ethan and Sam go public, Marianne, Nick and Max take the opportunity to practice their "casual faces." Lisa receives shocking news.

episodes.title: The Wedding
episodes.summary: Max and Felix's big day arrives -- and so does the drama as secrets are revealed, confessions are made, and poorly timed punches are thrown.
